name: A
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high fidelity, production-grade website design comp for MamAlina Center, a Hebrew RTL personal strength-training studio and separate breathing clinic in Kfar Szold, Israel. This is CONCEPT A: THE FILM, a dramatically rethought luxury athletic campaign website inspired by the compositional quality of Equinox and Third Space, with its own identity.

LAYOUT FIRST: Render a flat full browser page design at 1440px wide, roughly 1500px tall, not a scene, not a device mockup. Show the opening viewport and the next two meaningful content regions. Top: a slim white navigation bar, new attached MamAlina Center logo at the RIGHT, four understated Hebrew navigation links in the middle, a black WhatsApp contact button at LEFT. Under it: ONE edge-to-edge cinematic photographic film frame filling almost the entire first viewport, no split hero columns, no cards. Use the supplied photograph of the actual woman strength training as subject and environment reference, preserving her recognizable face, body and pose. Render the existing training environment with an art-directed black-and-white crop, keeping her face clear in the left half. Overlay extremely confident large heavy modern Hebrew sans typography on the right, with proper Hebrew direction, reading "כוח. נשימה." and below "חיים בתנועה." The main visible CTA below the headline is white rectangular, reading "בואו נדבר". Below CTA one tiny line "אימוני כוח וקליניקה לנשימה בכפר סאלד". At the bottom of the film frame, fine video progress geometry and a small pause control imply a real video background. This is the only cinematic UI signature, no dashboards or fake stats. The hero bottom runs into a light section with enormous black typography "חזקים יותר. בדיוק כמו שאתם." and a small real coaching description to the right. Next show two broad photograph-driven service entries labeled "אימוני כוח" and "נשימה וריברסינג", each with a simple arrow link, asymmetrical rather than identical cards. Continue a little below with a beautiful large trainer portrait area so it clearly reads as a complete webpage.

WORLD: new geometric heart/MA monogram logo must match the attached exact asset in shape and lettering "MamAlina Center"; the logo's warm taupe is a restrained brand accent. Page material is crisp gallery white, graphite black, warm taupe #AF9987, and cinematic monochrome photography. Strong athletic grotesque type, modern Hebrew heavy sans, very large scale, clean optical spacing. Feel premium, confident, editorial and alive. All controls native and usable, no glass, no neon glow, no pastel rounded cards, no numbered feature grid, no stock gym metrics. Must look like work by a top independent digital studio, completely different from a tan and black two-column landing page. Keep the real supplied brand and physical identity. No invented awards, prices, member numbers, testimonials, facilities, or booking schedules. Core real labels in Hebrew; all other small text may be plausible greeked UI lines. The composition must look like a sharp website screenshot rather than a poster.
